activity_summary: Abel Garnish said the property hand was missing again and must be a bladder until Saturday. You left the Roman unnamed. John Heminges kept the ten shillings until after the play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Agreed to the bladder and did not name the Roman.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Reported the missing hand and kept Saturday as the day it returns.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Held the wage book until after the play.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Mentioned in A bladder till Saturday

entities.name: ten shillings
entities.context: Mentioned in A bladder till Saturday

facets.activity: Left the property hand a bladder

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The property hand has gone missing again.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am dead by the fourth act.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Ten shillings apiece is after the play, not at this rehearsal.
